R0200.title: Layer 2 Bridging Risk
R0200.definition: Asset bridges between Layer2 scaling solutions (Rollup, sidechains) and mainchain have security vulnerabilities that may result in funds being locked or stolen.

references.title: Blockchain Cross-Chain Bridge Security: Challenges, Solutions, and ...

R0200.description:
Layer 2 bridging risk sits in asset locking, message validation, exit proofs, and relayer workflows between the base chain and rollups, sidechains, or app chains. A validation flaw or privileged key abuse can lock funds or release assets incorrectly.

Bridges often hold large liquidity and depend on complex on-chain and off-chain coordination. Security review must cover contracts, proof systems, operational keys, delay windows, and emergency exits.
R0200.influence: Bridge failures can lock or incorrectly release cross-layer assets, creating large liquidity losses and user confidence damage.

observables: Cross-chain bridge locked assets and counterparty issued amounts remain persistently inconsistent
Bridge message verification or exit-proof flows show anomalous invocation patterns
Relayer or validator sets undergo anomalous permission or membership changes within a short window
Large bridge withdrawals target historically unrelated new addresses with no corresponding deposits
Bridge delay windows are abnormally shortened or bypassed
